contract.capture_transaction: short SERIALIZABLE transaction selecting exact heads, pre-materialized verified aggregate-root bytes, sorted root membership and disclosure, and one build event
contract.build_scope: deterministic uncompressed logical member-set assembly outside the transaction from captured immutable root bytes and the release closure's preverified nested inventory only; no tar, zip, compression, or aggregate container bytes are defined or claimed
contract.ready_transaction: verify manifest and exact bytes before pending-to-ready transition
contract.retry_scope: retry the same capture; never recapture current heads or membership
contract.idempotency_rule: same application key replays the exact immutable pending create result; evidence.export.get/v1 reads pending or ready lifecycle status without a key
contract.download_rule: ready-only exact kind-and-digest selection of reserved bundle.json or manifest.json, a captured delivery=included root member, or a deterministic Included nested ArtifactRef in the captured release closure; external-required roots never resolve through producer GET; status counts included roots plus unique nested bodies, publishes both reserved digests, and manifest plus release-closure bytes enumerate the exact producer-addressable selectors
contract.snapshot_claim_limit: unauthenticated producer snapshot label only; no current, latest, export-readiness, or capture-integrity claim
contract.runtime_qualification_gate: runtime qualification requires exact retained bytes for the outer manifest, direct accepted-artifact Release closure and every selected artifact, every P8 remote-authority envelope in the caller-anchored record set, and every operation-conditional remote-attempt companion; a clean proof-verifier/remote-evidence-v2 must verify artifact and Release-proof semantics, P8 remote authority, and companion preimages independently, enforce every cross-link, and execute Complete, Incomplete, and Invalid scenarios; this unmaterialized contract or any descriptor-only fixture cannot produce an observed Complete report

composition.composition_rule: verify accepted artifact and Release-proof semantics directly, verify the caller-anchored P8 remote authority and exact attempt companions independently, then enforce every frozen cross-link
composition.p6_compatibility: AuthorityEvidenceBundleV1 and proof-verifier/authority-evidence-bundle-v1 remain unchanged for historical local evidence and are neither required nor relabeled for a remote attempt
composition.authority_entrypoint: P8 remote actor, decision, consequence, and authority chain only
composition.caller_trust_rule: usable release and remote-authority key bytes, accepted policy profiles, registry allowlists, initial remote head, and checkpoints are caller-controlled; producer hints never create trust
